# Who gets what from the trip?

> Free settlement calculator for commercial fishing boats. Enter the catch, fuel, ice, bait and food, the boat share and each crew share; get every payout, the boat's true trip profit and the gross sales needed to pay a deckhand your target. Nothing uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
